name: universal-compiler
description: Build the active source file with Universal Compiler.

universalCompiler.pythonPath.description: Python executable used to launch UniversalCompiler.py.

universalCompiler.scriptPath.description: Path to the UniversalCompiler.py CLI entry point.

universalCompiler.backend.description: Optional backend override, for example nuitka or bun.

universalCompiler.profile.description: Named project profile passed to the core build command.

universalCompiler.target.description: Target platform requested from the selected backend.

universalCompiler.architecture.description: Target architecture requested from the selected backend.

universalCompiler.verify.description: Request static artifact verification from the core command.

universalCompiler.recordDiagnostics.description: Retain privacy-safe local diagnostics for this extension build.

universalCompiler.adapters.description: Explicitly allow namespaced external adapter entry points.
